question.text: How many molecules of RMgX are consumed in the above given reaction?

solution.text: Here 4 Grignard reagent molecules are used as 1 each for  <math><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><msubsup><mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>∕</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>∖</mo></mrow></msubsup><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  and 2 for  <math><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>  group.
